Trigger: Project enters managed lifecycle and has owner, scope intent, and first gate.
Project is active during weekly digest cycle.
Next gate is inside lead time and requires readiness attention.
Gate is approved or completed.
Send Rule: Bundle into weekly digest unless material

Trigger: Project reaches completion, release/rollout handoff, or post-release closure.
Primary Audience: Project stakeholders and leadership as needed

Trigger: Status, confidence, risk, scope, user exposure, or stakeholder expectation changes materially.
Next gate ETA, release expectation, rollout timing, or committed milestone changes materially.
Send Rule: Review then send if material; otherwise digest

Trigger: Gate does not happen as planned, fails readiness, or decision is no-go / conditional.
Primary Audience: Project stakeholders and leadership as needed

Trigger: New bug is classified as critical, or existing bug is escalated to critical.
Send Rule: Approval required unless emergency protocol says send immediately

Trigger: Critical bug investigation is active and owner is assigned.
Fix owner is assigned and remediation is underway.
Fix is ready for validation or actively being validated.
Fix has passed validation and is ready to enter release flow.
Send Rule: Review then send; then hand off to release flow

Trigger: Bug moves backward, such as Fix in QA back to Investigating or Fix in progress.
Expected fix, QA, or release-readiness timing slips materially.
Primary Audience: Prior critical bug audience and leadership

Trigger: Attempted fix does not resolve issue or introduces unacceptable risk.
Primary Audience: Prior critical bug audience and leadership

Trigger: Story enters intake outside project, bug, or release flow.
Send Rule: Log only; bundle into prioritization agenda

Trigger: Weekly prioritization meeting completes.
Primary Audience: Prioritization group and requesters as needed

Trigger: Story is accepted, rejected, deferred, attached, converted, or reclassified.
Story becomes managed project.
Story becomes bug or incident.
Release receives a planned production schedule.
Primary Audience: Release stakeholders, support, operations, impacted teams

Trigger: Release decision window opens.
Production release begins.
Production release completes successfully.
Primary Audience: Release stakeholders, support, operations, impacted teams
Reviewer / Approver: QA / Lead PM if known issues

Trigger: Release schedule changes, misses planned timing, or is delayed during execution.
Primary Audience: Release stakeholders and leadership if material

Trigger: Release is fully or partially rolled back.
Rollback, critical bug, failed gate, or material issue requires root-cause review.
Primary Audience: Affected phase owners and leadership as needed
